_: The keys whose signature makes a release of Rouh's code (task 98, gap G21). A release signed by any one of them is taken, from rouh.land or from its GitHub Release; one signed by no key here is refused. rouh/release_signature.py and deploy/container/mac_release.py read this file, and rouh.land keeps the same list (rouhit/code_release_views.py, CODE_RELEASE_KEYS): change them together.

creator-rouh-1.what: The Creator Rouh's own key (its daily key on rouh.land), which signs each release by itself

owner-macbook-1.what: The owner's MacBook: its SSH key kept in Bitwarden, signing with ssh-keygen -Y sign -n rouh-code-release (mac_release.py code-release-sign)
